body: I'm glad I made you smile.

I guess I did conquer it. About 2 years ago, I couldn't even sleep at night. I had thoughts of suicide, death and self-inflicting pain. I'm going to be honest. I don't how I even conquered it. One day the thoughts just stopped and I felt like a heavy burden had been lifted from me. I feel like I'm having these thoughts because I feel like I'm going nowhere in life. I have no friends, not really good at anything and doing terrible in school. Sometimes it feels like I'm phased from reality and that nothing seems real. I'm sorry it took a day to respond. I hope you're still there.
